title: Show mode-specific dates (RTGS date vs Cheque date) in Reports

requirements.text: Persist mode-specific payment dates in the backend by extending the PaymentEntry model to include optional chequeDate and bankTransferDate fields, and wire these through addPayment and editPayment so the frontend can store the entered dates for Cheque and NEFT/RTGS/UPI payments.

quotes: In Report column if it's RTGS payment I need RTGS Date and if it's Cheque payment I need cheque date..is this possible

acceptanceCriteria: Backend PaymentEntry includes optional fields for chequeDate and bankTransferDate (both nullable/optional).
backend/main.mo addPayment accepts and stores chequeDate and bankTransferDate when applicable.
backend/main.mo editPayment accepts and updates chequeDate and bankTransferDate when applicable.
Payment entry UI (PaymentEntryPage) sends chequeDate for cheque lines and transferDate for online lines to the backend.
Edit payment UI (EditPaymentEntryPage) allows admins to view/update the mode-specific date field for the selected mode and sends it to the backend.
Existing payment entries that predate this change continue to work with missing (null) chequeDate/bankTransferDate values.

requirements.text: Update the on-screen Reports ledger table to display a single "Payment Date" value that is conditional by payment mode: show bankTransferDate for NEFT/RTGS/UPI payments, show chequeDate for Cheque payments, otherwise fall back to the createdTimestamp date.

quotes: In Report column if it's RTGS payment I need RTGS Date and if it's Cheque payment I need cheque date..is this possible

acceptanceCriteria: RetailerLedgerTable shows a Payment Date column/value derived as: bankTransferDate (if mode=bankTransfer and present) else chequeDate (if mode=cheque and present) else createdTimestamp.
When the relevant mode-specific date is not present (older records), the UI falls back to createdTimestamp without errors.
Displayed date formatting remains consistent with existing report date formatting (en-IN locale).

requirements.text: Update the exported CSV report to include a "Payment Date" column that is conditional by payment mode: bankTransferDate for NEFT/RTGS/UPI, chequeDate for Cheque, otherwise createdTimestamp; keep other existing export columns unchanged.

quotes: In Report column if it's RTGS payment I need RTGS Date and if it's Cheque payment I need cheque date..is this possible

acceptanceCriteria: exportReportsToXlsx adds/updates a CSV column named "Payment Date" populated as: bankTransferDate (bank transfer) else chequeDate (cheque) else createdTimestamp.
Export succeeds without runtime errors when mode-specific dates are null/missing.
CSV values for Payment Date match the on-screen semantics for the same payment rows.

requirements.text: Add a conditional migration for existing stable data so previously stored PaymentEntry records are upgraded with null chequeDate and null bankTransferDate fields, without changing any existing payment amounts or invoice balances.

quotes: In Report column if it's RTGS payment I need RTGS Date and if it's Cheque payment I need cheque date..is this possible

acceptanceCriteria: On canister upgrade, existing stored payments are preserved and new date fields default to null.
After upgrade, getAllPayments/getReportsData continue to return all existing payments successfully.
No invoice balances or statuses are modified by the migration.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose existing UI components instead.
nonGoals: Adding new payment modes or changing the meaning of PaymentType (invoice vs excess).
Changing report filtering logic (date range, salesman, type, mode) beyond using the new mode-specific date for display/export.
Implementing third-party integrations or external databases.
